job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting services published in 2017?
job.acceptance: November27,2017 at 4:30pm HST; equivalent date/time format accepted.

reviews.reason: This is a 2025 Oklahoma Teachers’ Retirement System investment consulting RFP, not the 2017 Hawaii ERS private equity consulting RFP. Its proposal deadline does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: The Teachers’ Retirement System of Oklahoma (TRS) is seeking proposals from qualified firms to provide investment consultant services.
The deadline for receipt of completed proposals is 4:00 p.m. Central Time, on January 14, 2026.
